name: vampire_gourmand_unblockable_only_this_turn
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card and this creature can't be blocked this turn.' Turn 1: the Gourmand attacks, seat 0 sacrifices its Bear: it draws a card and seat 1's Bear is never asked to block; seat 1 takes 2. Turn 3 (seat 0 draws in its draw step): the Gourmand attacks again and seat 0 declines the sacrifice: no card from it (seat 0 holds 2), and seat 1's Bear may block it, and does (the turn-1 'can't be blocked' has ended).
